summary: Grow/prepare a three-system sample matrix (SPS Bi0.3Sb1.7Te3 doping series, Na-doped PbTe, SnSe b-axis crystals), characterize full transport from 300 K to above 900 K, and feed every result into the programmatic hypothesis verifier.
samples: Bi0.3Sb1.7Te3 SPS pellets, melt-spun vs. gently ground powders, annealed 753 K
Bi2Te3 melt-spun ribbons, annealing series 673-813 K
Na-doped PbTe single crystals, Na 0.5-2.0 at.%
SnSe single crystals, b-axis oriented, carrier-tuned 1e17-1e19 cm-3

measurements.technique: laser flash diffusivity + DSC specific heat + density
laser flash total kappa with Wiedemann-Franz electronic subtraction (kappa_e = L*sigma*T)
combined S-sigma-kappa synthesis on PPMS/LFA setup
